name: context-canvas-codex
description: Optional session task maps with explicit long-context references and one-shot historical captures for Codex App and CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Navigate session work and offload retrievable context.
interface.longDescription: Adds an optional session map for goals, decisions, progress, dependencies, blockers, and next steps. Large textual results can be offloaded into explicit, bounded, searchable references, retrieved in chunks, or viewed through explicit deterministic exact-slice lenses for logs and line-oriented search results. Derived previews are ephemeral and never replace the stored body. A separate PostToolUse history capture is off by default and stores only the next explicitly requested callback. Trusted hook IDs provide transport provenance for Canvas actions; missing Canvas state never blocks the underlying task and Canvas is not an authority, workflow engine, WAL, or source of truth.
defaultPrompt: Create or restore an optional task map when navigation or offload would add value.
List my recent task canvases and continue the relevant lineage here.
Store, search, preview, or retrieve explicit references and opted-in historical tool snapshots for this task.
